title: Existence and uniqueness of the global conservative solutions for the generalized Camassa-Holm equation with dual-power nonlinearities
summary: In this paper, we investigate the global conservative solutions to the generalized Camassa-Holm equation with dual-power nonlinearities. By introducing a new set of variables, we transform the original equation into an equivalent semi-linear system, which allows us to establish the global existence of conservative solutions.
